```abap
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  R_MODIFY_BUTTONS_OUT
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       RPY_DYNPRO_READ:                                               *
*       für Radio- und Checkbuttons: Zusammenfassen von Buttonfeld und *
*       Textfeld zu einem einzigen externen Feld und Bestimmen des     *
*       Positionsattributes                                            *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*      -->P_FIELD_LIST_INT_E   erweit. Feldliste zum Container   (int.)*
*      <->P_DYNP_FIELD_LIST    Feldliste zum Container           (ext.)*
*      -->P_CONT_ATTR          akt. Container                    (ext.)*
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM R_MODIFY_BUTTONS_OUT
             TABLES P_FIELD_LIST_INT_E  TYPE FIELDLIST_INT_EXTEND
                    P_DYNP_FIELD_LIST   type DYFATC_tab
             USING  P_CONT_ATTR         TYPE RPYTY_DYNP_CONTAINER_ATTR.
STATICS: INT_B_PART      TYPE FIELD_INT_E,
         INT_T_PART      TYPE FIELD_INT_E,
         EXT_B_PART      TYPE RPYTY_DYNP_FIELD,
         EXT_T_PART      TYPE RPYTY_DYNP_FIELD,
         EXT_T_PART_ORIG TYPE RPYTY_DYNP_FIELD,
         EXT_B_INDEX TYPE I,
         EXT_T_INDEX TYPE I.

* Schleife über die Check- und Radiobuttonfelder (intern) des aktuellen
* Containers
  LOOP AT P_FIELD_LIST_INT_E WHERE FIELD-FILL CA 'AC'
                             AND   FIELD-FLG1 O FLG1EDT
                             AND   CONT_NAME = P_CONT_ATTR-NAME
                             AND   CONT_TYPE = P_CONT_ATTR-TYPE.

*   1. echtes Button-Feld (intern) gefunden
    INT_B_PART = P_FIELD_LIST_INT_E.
*   2. zugehöriges Textfeld (intern) suchen
    INT_T_PART = SPACE.
    LOOP AT P_FIELD_LIST_INT_E WHERE FIELD-FILL = INT_B_PART-FIELD-FILL
                               AND   FIELD-AUTH = INT_B_PART-FIELD-AUTH
                               AND   FIELD-FNAM = INT_B_PART-FIELD-FNAM
                               AND   FIELD-FLG1 Z FLG1EDT.
      INT_T_PART = P_FIELD_LIST_INT_E.
      EXIT.
```
